R0240.title: Unauthorized Use of Shared Data
R0240.definition: Business teams, suppliers, or partners use shared data beyond the authorized purpose.
R0240.description:
Unauthorized use of shared data occurs when internal teams, vendors, or partners use shared data beyond approved purpose, scope, or duration. It can appear in joint modeling, marketing activation, outsourced operations, and data API integrations.

Even if initial sharing was approved, later purpose drift creates compliance and trust risk. Organizations need data use contracts, purpose audits, masking, isolation, and expiration handling.
R0240.influence: Purpose drift in shared data can trigger privacy complaints, contract breach, regulatory action, and loss of partner trust.
